title: 生态研究词汇
goal: 辨认生态研究词汇并理解现象与解释。

points.label: 辨认生态研究的常用词
听懂生态研究中的现象与解释

sources.title: 雅思 IELTS Academic：课表
sources.used: 生态研究词汇与听力课教学规格

body.p: 生态研究讲生物和环境的关系。栖息地是生物生活的地方。种群变化是一个区域内某一物种数量的变化。
保护措施针对某种具体的压力或栖息地条件。听录音时，观察到的变化和研究者提出的解释要分开记。

body.box: Recording: Researchers counted reed nests in a restored wetland. The count rose after water levels were maintained during the breeding season. The team suggested that stable water gave birds more suitable nesting sites; the observations alone did not establish the cause.

body.p: 观察对象是湿地里的 reed nests，变化是巢的数量上升。水位稳定、合适的筑巢地点变多，这是研究团队的解释。观察本身没有证实这个原因。
restored 是经过修复，说的是湿地。maintained 是保持不变，说的是繁殖季节的水位。

groups.fill: A class studied a small pond. The hab{itat} supported i{ts} native pla{nts} and shel{tered} insects. Resea{rchers} surveyed sev{eral} sites dur{ing} spring a{nd} recorded ev{ery} occupied ne{st} carefully. They recorded water levels and the surrounding vegetation. Their records showed an increase in nests, although seasonal variation could also affect the result. The group suggested regular monitoring and proposed that visitors should reduce disturbance. The work formed part of a local conservation project, which also included careful observations at another nearby site.
notes: Researchers：指进行调查的研究人员。
during：during spring 表示在春季期间。
every：every occupied nest 指每一个有鸟使用的巢。
nest：occupied nest 指有鸟使用的巢。

lines.text: Today we will consider a small study of insects in a meadow. A local team marked ten areas of equal size and counted butterflies in each area on several dry mornings. The team also recorded the number of flowering plants. The areas were visited in the same order on each day, and the observers used the same counting method. In the records, areas with more flowering plants generally had more butterflies. The team suggested that flowers might provide food, but the survey did not establish that flowers caused the difference. Other features could also vary among the areas. One section of the meadow was cut before the survey. It had fewer flowering plants than the uncut section during the visits. The team proposed delaying cutting in part of the meadow and continuing the counts in later seasons. This was a management proposal, not a result of the survey. Repeated observations would help show whether the pattern persists, although a separate comparison would be needed to investigate the effect of the change. The team recorded the weather as well because butterfly activity can differ with conditions. Counts made only in dry weather cannot describe activity on wet days. The report therefore distinguished the observed association from the suggested explanation, and it described the limits of the method. The local project used the findings to plan further monitoring rather than claiming that a single survey proved the effectiveness of delayed cutting.

items.stem: What did the team count to compare insect activity in equal-sized areas?
options: Butterflies in each marked area
Flowering plants in each area
Insects of every kind in each area
Butterflies on wet and dry mornings
items.why: 依据是 counted butterflies in each area on several dry mornings。计数的是每块区域里的蝴蝶，即第一项。开花植物是另外记录的。

items.stem: What pattern appeared in the records?
options: Areas with more flowers had fewer butterflies.
Flower-rich areas usually had more butterflies.
More cutting always accompanied more flowers.
More butterflies appeared only on wet days.
items.why: 依据是 areas with more flowering plants generally had more butterflies。花多的区域，蝴蝶通常也多，即第二项。

items.stem: What explanation did the team suggest?
options: Flowers were proven to cause the difference.
Cutting part of the meadow increased flowers.
Flowers might provide butterflies with food.
Weather explained the butterfly numbers.
items.why: 依据是 The team suggested that flowers might provide food，即第三项。录音紧接着说调查没有证明花是原因，所以第一项说过了头。

items.stem: What did the team propose for part of the meadow?
options: Cutting the whole meadow earlier
Ending the counts after one season
Planting more flowers in each area
Delaying the cutting of vegetation
items.why: 依据是 The team proposed delaying cutting in part of the meadow，即第四项。团队还提出以后几个季节继续计数。

items.stem: What limitation did the report identify?
options: The association alone did not establish a cause.
The equal areas were counted by different methods.
The team recorded flowers but omitted butterflies.
The survey compared only observations on wet days.
items.why: 依据是 the survey did not establish that flowers caused the difference。花和蝴蝶数量有关联，但调查没有证明原因，即第一项。

groups.fill: A team studied birds in woodland. The popul{ation} was asse{ssed} through repe{ated} surveys o{f} occupied ne{sts}. Researchers meas{ured} their distri{bution} across si{tes} and cou{nted} the ne{sts} carefully. They also recorded the surrounding vegetation and the amount of shade. A decline in nest numbers prompted further monitoring, but the researchers avoided naming a cause without more evidence. They discussed how to reduce disturbance and whether to replant trees. The records will be compared with later observations from the same sites.

lines.text: A research group examined young trees in two areas of a woodland. Both areas contained the same tree species, but one had a fence and the other did not. The group counted young trees in equally sized plots each spring for three years. At the end of the period, the fenced plots had more young trees than the unfenced plots. The researchers also noted signs of browsing on some unfenced trees. They suggested that the fence may have reduced browsing by deer, allowing more young trees to survive. This explanation remains a hypothesis because the two areas may have differed in other ways before the fence was installed. The team had not measured the initial number of young trees. It therefore could not attribute the whole difference to the fence. The researchers proposed measuring tree numbers before fencing additional plots and then comparing changes in fenced and unfenced plots. They would also record light and soil moisture, which might affect growth. The original survey counted trees rather than measuring the height of each one, so it cannot show whether the trees inside the fence grew taller. The fenced area was not described as free of all browsing; the observations concerned signs seen on some trees. The work illustrates how a count can reveal a difference while leaving its cause uncertain. A future study with measurements before and after fencing could provide a stronger basis for evaluating the proposed explanation.

options: Young trees in equal-sized plots
Deer seen at each woodland fence
Signs of browsing on the trees
The height of each young tree
items.why: 依据是 The group counted young trees in equally sized plots，即第一项。啃食痕迹只是另外注意到的情况。

items.stem: What difference was observed at the end of the period?
options: The unfenced plots had more young trees.
The fenced plots had more young trees.
Both areas had exactly the same count.
The fenced trees were all measured as taller.
items.why: 依据是 the fenced plots had more young trees than the unfenced plots。有围栏的样地幼树更多，即第二项。第一项把两种样地说反了。

items.stem: What explanation did the researchers suggest?
options: Light and soil moisture caused the difference.
The fence caused all browsing to cease.
The fence may have reduced deer browsing.
The fence changed the species in each plot.
items.why: 依据是 They suggested that the fence may have reduced browsing by deer，即第三项。录音只说减少了啃食，没有说围栏内完全没有啃食，所以第二项说过了头。

items.stem: Why could the survey not attribute the entire difference to the fence?
options: The heights of the trees were not measured.
Browsing was seen only on fenced trees.
Each area had a different tree species.
The trees were not counted before fencing.
items.why: 依据是 The team had not measured the initial number of young trees. It therefore could not attribute the whole difference to the fence。装围栏前没有数过幼树，即第四项。

items.stem: What did the researchers propose for a later study?
options: Comparing plots before and after additional fencing
Replacing counts with observations of deer alone
Removing the existing fence before all measurements
Counting trees without recording light or moisture
items.why: 依据是 measuring tree numbers before fencing additional plots and then comparing changes。新样地装围栏前后都要计数，即第一项。
